paragraphs: Are you feeling overwhelmed by the plethora of boat tour options in Budapest?
Then let me help you choose the best boat tour for you, with the best guide on the topic in existence.

To give honest, accurate and credible recommendations on the best river cruises in Budapest (and the best dinner cruises in Budapest), I decided to personally test the most popular cruises of every major cruise company in Budapest, backed up with photos, videos and many intricate details.

As the person with the most boat tour laps on the Danube under his belt, I have handpicked the 10 best river cruises in Budapest from my many voyages based on their exceptional quality, uniqueness, or value for money.
